name: Gensoukyou Labyrinth - Welcome to Lunatic Festival!!
original_name: 幻想鏡らびリンス Welcome to Lunatic Festival!!
source:
A collection of Tohou fan materials from 35 participants gathered at "Luna Festival" held on March 2, 2008 and distributed as one piece.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2008年3月2日举办的“月神祭”上，收集了35名参加者的东方同人资料，并作为一件进行分发。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
